target_definition: Daily positive item transaction sales, units, seven daily horizons; observed-sales demand proxy, not latent demand
uncertainty_reason: Point-only study; no calibrated prediction interval
warnings: Point forecasts only: calibrated prediction intervals are not produced.
No empirical MR D.I.Y. accuracy claim; synthetic company mechanics are separate.
No inventory, lead-time, stockout, delivery or operating-cost ground truth.
Known-item temporal evaluation only; cold-start and cross-company performance not established.
Retrospective transaction-time availability assumption; historical system-known replay and late-update logs unavailable.
Complete-ledger observation scope is source-declared, not independently audited; missing SKU-day zeros mean zero recorded positive sales, never latent demand.
